record: Source: City of Chicago Data Portal, Contracts (rsxa-ify5), https://data.cityofchicago.org/Administration-Finance/Contracts/rsxa-ify5, read 2026-10-27. Awards and changes approved 2023-10-27 to 2026-10-27, and contracts whose latest end date falls from 2026-10-27 to 2027-10-27, both days included. An award of 0 on a blanket contract means the City orders as needed and promises no amount. Negative amounts are changes that took money out. Award totals are not unit prices. Vendor addresses are not included; "Name withheld" marks a vendor name that does not read as a business.
Trade words: demolition, wrecking. Purchases of goods, fleet upkeep, design and engineering, software, art, grants, leases and redevelopment deals are left out.
